hook: Your hike in Peru ends at a striped mountain.
title: Your Peru Hike Ends at a Striped Mountain
description:
Vinicunca in Peru looks painted in red, yellow and turquoise bands. The colours come from real minerals in the rock layers. It is known as Rainbow Mountain. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Peru #Geography
comment_prompt: Would you hike it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your hike in Peru ends at a striped mountain.
scenes.headline: STRIPED MOUNTAIN

scenes.narration: Red, yellow and turquoise bands run across it.

scenes.narration: Ice that once covered it melted away.

scenes.narration: Then the colours showed up for hikers.

scenes.narration: Your striped mountain in Peru is completely real.
